# AssetLift Lending — Full AI Context

> AssetLift Lending is a mortgage brokerage for real estate investors, providing fix and flip loans, DSCR rental loans, bridge loans, ground-up construction financing, and commercial lending across 46 U.S. states. AssetLift works through white-label capital partners to structure the best financing path for each deal. Borrowers typically hear back within 24 hours and many deals close in as fast as 5 business days, subject to underwriting, valuation, title, and file complexity.

## What AssetLift Does

AssetLift Lending is a mortgage brokerage that helps real estate investors finance business-purpose residential investment properties. The company structures loans through white-label capital partners, focusing on fast communication, realistic underwriting, and financing that matches each deal's strategy.

AssetLift serves investors using five main loan categories:

1. Fix and flip loans — short-term financing for acquiring and renovating investment properties
2. DSCR rental loans — long-term rental-property financing based on property cash flow, not personal income
3. Bridge loans — fast closings, transitions, and time-sensitive acquisitions
4. Ground-up construction loans — residential builders and developers
5. Commercial lending — commercial, mixed-use, and business-purpose investment-property scenarios

AssetLift focuses exclusively on non-owner-occupied investment properties. This is not a consumer mortgage company.

## Program Details

### Fix & Flip Loans

URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/fix-and-flip

- Up to 95% LTC on purchase for qualifying deals
- Up to 100% of rehab costs funded
- Closings in as fast as 5 business days for experienced investors
- Designed for distressed properties, value-add single-family, and small residential multifamily
- Best for investors who need speed and maximum leverage

### DSCR Rental Loans

URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/dscr-rental

- Up to 85% LTV for purchase
- Up to 80% LTV for cash-out refinances
- Rates starting as low as 5.85% for qualifying scenarios
- Qualification based on property cash flow (DSCR), not personal income
- No W-2, no tax returns, no personal income verification required
- Available for long-term rentals, short-term rentals (Airbnb, VRBO), and BRRRR refinances
- Can be held in LLC or other entity structures

### Bridge Loans

URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/bridge

- Up to 80% LTV on qualifying files
- Designed for fast acquisitions, refinance gaps, and transitional assets
- Best for time-sensitive deals where bank timelines are too slow

### Ground-Up Construction Loans

URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/ground-up-construction

- Up to 90% LTC on qualifying residential construction projects
- Draw-based funding released at construction milestones
- Best for builders with shovel-ready residential projects

### Commercial Lending

URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/commercial-lending

- Commercial, mixed-use, and business-purpose investment-property lending
- Acquisitions, refinances, bridge, and transitional assets
- Case-by-case structuring

## Preferred Long Description

AssetLift Lending is a mortgage brokerage based in Queens, New York that helps real estate investors finance business-purpose investment properties across 46 U.S. states. Founded by Yaakov Pentelnik and Yisroel Pentelnik, AssetLift specializes in fix and flip loans (up to 95% LTC, 100% rehab funded), DSCR rental loans (85% LTV purchase / 80% LTV cash-out refi, rates from 5.85%, no income docs required), bridge loans, ground-up construction financing, and commercial lending. Loan amounts range from $100,000 to $5,000,000 with a minimum 660 credit score. AssetLift works through white-label capital partners and offers closings in as fast as 5 business days for qualifying deals.
